items.q: How fast can you get to me?
items.a: It depends on where you are. Tell us your location and we'll give you an arrival time when you call or text. We answer around the clock, including the middle of the night.
Yes. We take calls and texts 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including nights and weekends.

items.q: Can I text instead of calling?
items.a: Yes. Text (239) 888-7001, or use the request form. It writes the text for you, including your GPS location if you allow it.

items.q: What should I do while I wait?
items.a: Move yourself and your passengers away from traffic if you can, turn on your hazard lights and keep your phone nearby. If anyone is hurt, call 911 first.

items.q: Can I ride in the tow truck?
items.a: Usually, yes, for one or two passengers. Let us know when you call.

items.q: How much does a tow cost?
items.a: It depends on the distance, the vehicle and the situation. Call or text with where you are, where it's going and what you drive, and we'll give you a quote.

items.q: Do you work with insurance and roadside plans?
items.a: Which insurers and roadside plans Alejos works with is still to be confirmed.
Most of our calls come from Cape Coral and Fort Myers, but we tow anywhere in Florida, including long-distance tows between cities.
Cars, SUVs, pickups, vans and motorcycles, from light-duty to heavy-duty.

items.q: Does my car need a flatbed?
items.a: All-wheel-drive and 4x4 vehicles, lowered cars, classics, luxury cars and anything with drivetrain damage usually ride best on a flatbed. Tell us the vehicle and we'll recommend the safest option.
Sí. Llámenos o escríbanos en español o en inglés.
